applicant.name: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Andrea Kainz
applicant.organisation: Department of Gynaecology, Tyrol University Hospital (hospital department)

purpose: We are investigating regional variation in the number of adults living with breast cancer to see whether our screening and follow-up clinics are located where patients actually live.
question: How many adults have breast cancer, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Report per region: adults with breast cancer.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics; the applicant never sees the data (Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 3: no Art. 54 or Art. 53(2) bar applies (a hospital department reviewing where to locate its clinics is care improvement) and the request is filed as a health data request.
